Services

Example Studio builds production-ready 3D characters for independent game teams. We sculpt, retopologise, unwrap, texture and rig each model so it drops into Unity or Unreal without rework. Every project starts with a short brief and a fixed scope, and you see progress renders at agreed checkpoints. Our artists have shipped characters for mobile, console and film projects over the past ten years. Example Studio builds production-ready 3D characters for independent game teams.
